item.name: Artifact Types

description.content: First-class, per-type artifact collections (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Arazzo, Postman, JSON Schema, and more). Each path filters and normalizes one artifact type across all providers.

item.name: List openapi specifications across the catalog.

request.name: List openapi specifications across the catalog.

description.content: First-class collection of openapi specifications across every provider on the network. Surfaces and normalizes the `OpenAPI` artifact type. Filter by free text, provider, and tags; pass `include=content` to inline each artifact body.

query.description: Free-text query over name and description (and tags where applicable).
Comma-separated provider slugs to scope results to.
Comma-separated tags to filter by. Tag names are Title Case (e.g. Messaging); lowercase slugs (e.g. messaging) are also accepted.
Whether results must match `any` (default) or `all` of the supplied tags.
Extra data to embed. `content` fetches and inlines artifact bodies.
Sort order.
1-based page number.
Items per page.

response.name: A page of openapi specifications with owning API and provider context.
Malformed request (bad parameter value).
response.body:
{

  "title": "Invalid parameter",
  "status": 400,
  "detail": "`match` must be one of: any, all.",

  "parameter": "match"
}
